body: ac-01 gate signed 2026-06-10: author approved the sizing memo as amended ('Approve as written') — 1,400 columns (9x90 battleground / 7x50 model-gap / 4x60 backbone), >=10pp detection target, adjudication cap 350 columns, ~30% external vendored+registered, GeoNames/CLDR lens-only under the decisive-lens rule. Review questions answered before signature: lineage (card-0018 registry chain) and GeoNames/CLDR exclusion rationale — see sizing_memo.md sections added 2026-06-10.

ac-02 progress 2026-06-10: GitTables share BUILT — scripts/build_gold_corpus_candidates.py draws 1,148 candidates deterministically (md5-order, seed-free) from v19_gated.parquet into eval/gold/gold_corpus_candidates.tsv; + 240 anchor seeds = 1,388/1,400. Two buckets per contested type (header_pos for recall, model_emit for FP-hunting), per-header cap 5, header-length<=64 and __index_level screens, no raw values in the fixture (anchor sanitisation convention). Backbone draws skip the is_trivial filter (the flag marks plain numeric/text wholesale — that IS the backbone population). Only hard shortfall: top_level_domain 12 cols. External share (~150-180 cols, BELOW the memo's ~30% aspiration — recorded deviation: GitTables filled every quota, external targets information not volume) is planned source-by-source with licences in eval/gold/gold_corpus_external_plan.md; fetch+register+draw is the next work item, then ac-03 lenses. ac-02 stays unchecked until external lands.

ac-02 external share executed 2026-06-10: 10 open datasets fetched, PII-screened (name columns stripped from NYC payroll/DOB, SF businesses before vendoring — repo is PUBLIC), vendored under eval/datasets/gold_external/ (~30MB), registered via dataset_register.py with NEW role=gold (added to the tool's choices), snapshots in eval/datasets/snapshots/gold-*.json. scripts/build_gold_corpus_external.py extracts 123 columns across all 18 strata incl. real utc offsets (OpenFlights), ISO country codes (OurAirports), UK postcodes + GBP amounts (HM Land Registry OGL-3.0), boundary cases by design (bare domains as url candidates, state-plane coords as lat/lon near-misses). Corpus total: 1,148 GitTables + 240 anchor + 123 external = 1,511 columns. DEVIATION from signed gate: external = 8.1% vs ~30% — column-yield per table (~12) is the constraint; ~40 tables needed for 30%. Surfaced to author for blessing; more tables is the crank if ac-07 shows a GitTables/external gap. Next: ac-03 three-lens pre-labeller.
